sections.heading: Workbench (Tier 1)
items: Stone Pickaxe – Wood + Stone; needed to mine copper and iron ore.
Stone Axe – Wood + Stone; faster tree harvesting and can chop hardwood.
Repair Hammer – Wood + Fiber; repairs buildings, ship parts, and equipment.
Basic Arrows – Wood + Feathers; required if you use a bow early.

sections.heading: Weaponsmith & Armor Workshop
items: Upgrade to copper and iron weapons as soon as possible. Copper ore is common in early caves; iron requires deeper ruins or harder islands.
Linen and Tanned Leather armor are the mid-game benchmarks. Flax grows in seedbeds; leather comes from hunted animals processed at the Tanning Rack.
Check durability after every major fight. Repairing at the station is cheaper than crafting new gear.

sections.heading: Shipwright's Workshop
items: Ship repair kits – keep a stack on board. They are the only mid-fight healing for your hull.
Cannonballs and Bar Shot – Bar Shot tears sails/rigging; Round Shot damages hull. Match ammo to the encounter.
Boarding gear – grappling hooks and ladders let you take enemy ships intact for better loot.

sections.heading: Alchemy & Cooking
items: Tannin is crafted at the Alchemy Table from Tree Bark. It enables Tanned Leather.
Gunpowder requires the Millstone and sulfur/saltpeter. Mass-produce it once you have a stable supply line.
Cooking gives two stacked buffs. Rotate a HP-regen food with a stamina food before combat.
